name: 复古方屏健康监测智能手表款

shots.intent: 以复古金属方壳悬浮于深底的高对比主图争夺搜索页一眼点击。
主图一秒法则：双机位并列＋一行大标题，把首要利益点一眼讲清。
shots.textZone: top-centre headline block plus one supporting line beneath it

shots.intent: 放大深夜久坐、消息与健康提醒全靠掏手机的日常摩擦。
俯拍佩戴生活方式镜头，让买家把自己代入日常通勤与咖啡桌场景。
正面特写屏幕功能列表＋右侧线框图标引线，回答这块屏到底能干什么。
shots.textZone: headline top-left plus a four-item label column on the right joined by hairline leader lines

shots.intent: 三种表壳配色同机位并列，让买家在下单前完成选色。
shots.textZone: one headline top-centre plus three short finish labels under the row

shots.intent: 侧面微距证明表壳滚花、表冠与侧键的加工精度，替代任何口头质量主张。
低角度微距看表带孔眼、活动圈与针扣，替硅胶佩戴舒适度做视觉证言。
低角度凝固泼水瞬间，以可见水珠与光逻辑演示日常防溅，不写等级数字。
俯视信息图用线框图标栅格承接规格与兼容信息，数值全部留为占位符待后期填真值。
shots.textZone: headline above the grid plus eight labelled cells with numbered circles in a two-by-four layout

shots.intent: 以开盖收纳礼盒＋一枚短按钮收口，兼顾自戴与送礼的下单动机。
shots.textZone: one headline line above a short CTA button at the bottom centre

style.backgroundSystem: seamless studio sweeps limited to the three locked base tones #3B2F29 / #DCD9D4 / #F7F5F2; no unrelated scenery, no location photography outside the lifestyle frame
style.iconSystem: thin monoline outline glyphs, uniform 2px stroke, rounded terminals, strokes drawn only from the locked palette
style.lightingSystem: large soft front-left key, thin #4FC3E8 rim highlight on metal edges, 5200-5800K, controlled specular falloff on brushed metal, soft grounded contact shadow, never a blown-out screen
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: one consistent premium retro-tech wearable visual system across the whole image set. Fixed palette: seamless base fields of deep matte studio tone #3B2F29, neutral matte stone tone #DCD9D4 and clean paper tone #F7F5F2, with a single accent of screen-glow #4FC3E8; product materials pinned to brushed knurled metal and matte silicone #2B2A29. Temperature: neutral, warm-leaning bases balanced by the crisp accent rim. Typography: modern geometric sans-serif only, one headline block plus short label lines, Chinese copy wrapped in 「」, no serif or handwritten faces. Background system: seamless studio sweeps built only from the three locked base tones, never unrelated scenery. Lighting system: large soft front-left key, thin rim highlight on metal edges, 5200K-5800K, controlled specular falloff, soft grounded contact shadow, no harsh cast shadow. Surface system: matte paper and stone sweeps, with crumpled cloth #2F3B4A and ceramic #E4E0DA permitted only in the lifestyle frame. Layout system: top-centre or left headline block, two-column and four-cell icon grids, hairline dividers and leader lines, numbered circles for spec cells. Icon system: thin monoline outline glyphs, uniform 2px stroke, rounded terminals. Product presentation rules: the case face and strap construction stay readable, product scale is stable between shots, the screen is never blown out, the watch face is a generic placeholder layout with no legible text. No drift: no palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no recoloured case finishes, no invented on-screen UI, no real phone-system logos, no watermarks, no QR codes or membership badges.
noDrift: no watermarks, QR codes or membership badges
style.presentationRules: square case face and strap construction always readable; stable product scale between shots; identical angle and light across variant units; watch face shown as a generic placeholder layout with no legible text; full-view frames kept at or below 40% of the set
style.surfaceSystem: matte paper and matte stone sweeps; brushed knurled metal case and matte silicone strap #2B2A29; lifestyle frames may add crumpled cloth #2F3B4A and ceramic #E4E0DA
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif only; one headline block plus short label lines; Chinese in-image copy wrapped in 「」 as placeholders; no serif, handwritten, retro or cartoon faces
